name: WidgetQuery

fields.name: chat
fields.description: Chat with the message containing the widget; omitted if the widget is in an inline message

fields.name: message_id
fields.description: Identifier of the message containing the widget; omitted if the widget is in an inline message

fields.name: inline_message_id
fields.description: Identifier of the inline message containing the widget

fields.name: chat_instance
fields.description: Global identifier, uniquely corresponding to the chat to which the message with the widget was sent

fields.name: chat_type
fields.description: For widgets in inline messages, type of the chat to which the message was sent. Can be either “sender” for a private chat with the inline query sender, “private”, “group”, “supergroup”, or “channel”.

fields.name: widget_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the shared widget, which sent the query; omitted if the widget isn't shared

description: This object represents an incoming query from a widget in a message sent by the bot or via the bot. Use answerWidgetQuery to answer the query. Each user can send at most 5 queries per 5 seconds to the bot from all its widgets.
